content:
I have been using the iPhone Duo for a bit over a month, and it has easily become my favorite tech product of 2026. Every time I use it, I feel an excitement that only comes from a product category this new. But because it’s so new and the form factor is something we have not seen from Apple, accessories for the Duo have been all over the place. It’s the Wild West for new cases and iPhone Duo accessories, and I love that! I have been testing a ton of new accessories, from different cases to perfectly contoured MagSafe battery packs and everything in between. These are some of my favorite accessories that every iPhone Duo needs to try out, especially with Black Friday season here!

I go hands-on with 12 different iPhone Duo cases in the video below. If you want to get a good sense of how these all work, I highly recommend watching the video!

One of the biggest challenges with the iPhone Duo is finding a MagSafe battery pack that actually fits the shorter, wider form factor. MagSafe accessories were made with the classic slab iPhone in mind. So if you try to connect your old MagSafe battery pack, it will technically start charging, but they are usually too long and hangs off the bottom. That is where the BMX SolidSafe Duo comes into play. It was purpose-built for the iPhone Duo. You get:

  • Square design made specifically to match the contours of the iPhone Duo
  • 5,000mAh battery
  • Up to 15W Qi2 wireless charging
  • Up to 20W wired USB-C charging
  • Built-in diagnostics display to view charging capacity and speed
  • 360-degree rotating kickstand
  • Built-in lanyard that doubles as a USB-C cable

What makes this thing so nice is that not only can you charge your iPhone Duo, but it also has an integrated stand, which is a must for viewing content on the inner display. I’m also a sucker for a diagnostics display.

The BMX SolidSafe Duo is on sale on Amazon for $59 (normally $79) and comes in black.

One thing I have learned from using the iPhone Duo every day is that having a secure grip makes a huge difference, especially when using it unfolded in one hand. The Aulumu G09 is one of those simple accessories that actually changes how you use the iPhone Duo. You get:

  • Integrated finger loop for secure one-handed use
  • Omnidirectional rotating design
  • Built-in kickstand that easily supports the iPhone Duo in all orientations
  • Metal construction and rigid hinges

I have tested a ton of different kickstands for the Duo, and this one has been the most versatile and gives me the most confidence when using it. The MagSafe magnets it uses are insanely strong, so you know it won’t accidentally be bumped off.

Aulumu has two versions. They have one made entirely of aluminum and available in two colors: black and white. Those are on sale for $36. They also have their G09 Ghost collection, which is the exact same product but uses a translucent rubber finish and comes in four colors: Yellow, Gray, Orange, and White. Those are on sale for $31.

This one is a no-brainer, especially at the current price point. If there is one Apple ecosystem product I would recommend, it would be the AirPods Pro 3. Right now, they are at their lowest price ever at just $149. That is $100 cheaper than getting them from Apple. For $149, you get:

  • Best-in-class Active Noise Cancellation
  • New hybrid foam and silicone ear tips
  • Up to eight hours of listening with ANC on and up to 24 hours with the included case
  • Built-in heart rate sensor
  • All the ecosystem features like:
    • Auto switching
    • Live translation
    • Transparency mode
    • Live listen
    • & more

If you have been thinking of getting AirPods Pro 3 for yourself or someone this holiday season, this is the time to get it. I have never seen them at such a low price. And of course, they pair magically with your iPhone Duo. You can get them for $149 on Amazon while supplies last.

One of the coolest things about the iPhone Duo is being able to use the outer display as a viewfinder while recording with the 48MP rear cameras. As someone who uses their iPhone for content creation, I find this feature awesome. The Shiftcam SnapStudio helps take that iPhone Duo versatility to the next level. You get:

  • MagSafe mounting with 180-degree rotation
  • Built-in LED ring light with 10-step color adjustment from 2500 K to 6000 K
  • USB-C rechargeable with 40 minutes of continuous use at the max brightness setting
  • Includes small tripod in packaging
  • Four mounting screw points to add other accessories

Being able to use the Duo’s main camera, see yourself on the outer display, and have a dedicated light, all in one compact, portable setup, is pretty incredible. I have been using this as my webcam solution alongside my Mac Studio. If you create content, record videos, or just want better, more convenient lighting, this is a must.

The Shiftcam SnapStudio light is on sale for $62, normally $89. Shiftcam also sells a creator bundle called the Creator Kit Pro that includes SnapGrip Pro, SnapStudio Light & SnapStand Max for $175.

Final thoughts

These are just four of the 12 accessories that I mentioned in the video. So, again, I highly recommend checking the video to see what else accessory makers have to offer for the iPhone Duo. The best part of the iPhone Duo is how new it all is. Every day I’m learning something new about it or finding a new way to use it, and the same goes for all the new accessories. This accessory ecosystem is slowly flourishing, and I am excited to see how it matures over time.

What are some of your favorite accessories for the iPhone Duo? What else should I check out?
